name: Tsukinohara Kuon
source:
Kuon is the lead guitarist of [rēve parfait].

As the leader of [rēve parfait], Kuon always takes the wishes of his bandmates into consideration. Very caring and a good conversationalist, he has a lot of friends. Since his father is a congressman and his mother is a lawyer, Kuon is polite and gets excellent grades. Since his parents are often away on business, the Tsukinohara family's house has become the band's hangout.

[Translation of [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/dynamic/reve/profile.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
